items.exampleEn: After the match, reporters bombarded the coach with questions.
items.exampleZh: 比賽結束後，記者們向教練連番提問。

items.exampleEn: Music piracy has become less common in recent years.
items.exampleZh: 近幾年音樂盜版已經沒那麼普遍了。

items.exampleEn: Loud music late at night infringes on the neighbors' right to rest.
items.exampleZh: 深夜大聲放音樂侵犯了鄰居休息的權利。

items.exampleEn: Students visited a museum that teaches about the Holocaust.
items.exampleZh: 學生們參觀了一座介紹納粹大屠殺的博物館。

items.exampleEn: In the old painting, a soldier on a white horse holds a long lance.
items.exampleZh: 那幅古畫裡，一名士兵騎著白馬，手拿一支長矛。

items.exampleEn: Any infringement of the rules will be reported to the coach.
items.exampleZh: 任何違反規則的行為都會報告給教練。

items.exampleEn: My uncle trained as a paratrooper when he was young.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔年輕時受過傘兵訓練。

items.exampleEn: The player was unjustly sent off the field, and the fans were angry.
items.exampleZh: 那名球員被不公正地罰下場，球迷都很生氣。

items.sentenceEn: Many people believe the old law treated farmers unjustly.
items.sentenceZh: 許多人認為那條舊法律對農民不公平。

items.audioEn: The paratroopers will jump at three o'clock, right after the band finishes playing.
items.audioZh: 傘兵會在三點跳傘，就在樂隊表演結束之後。

items.sentenceEn: The library has a large section of books about the Holocaust.
items.sentenceZh: 圖書館有一大區關於納粹大屠殺的書。

items.sentenceEn: Piracy was common along this coast three hundred years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 三百年前，這一帶海岸常有海盜出沒。

items.stemEn: The company lost millions of dollars because of software ____.
items.stemZh: 那家公司因為軟體盜版損失了數百萬美元。

items.stemEn: Using someone's photo on your website without asking may ____ their rights.
items.stemZh: 沒經過同意就把別人的照片用在你的網站上，可能會侵犯他們的權利。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our town held a history festival in the castle park. In the morning, actors dressed as soldiers from long ago rode horses and showed how people once fought with lances. Near the gate, children bombarded a guide with questions about the old guns on the castle walls. In the afternoon, the modern part of the show began: a team of paratroopers jumped from a plane and landed right in the middle of the park. It was quite a spectacle, and the crowd cheered loudly.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們鎮在城堡公園舉辦了一場歷史節。早上，演員打扮成古代士兵騎著馬，示範以前的人怎麼用長矛作戰。大門旁，孩子們圍著導覽員，連番問起城牆上那些古老火炮的問題。下午，表演的現代部分登場：一隊傘兵從飛機上跳下，正好降落在公園中央。那場面十分壯觀，觀眾大聲歡呼。

questions.questionZh: 早上的表演內容是什麼？
options: 導覽員帶大家參觀城堡內部
一隊傘兵從飛機上跳下來

items.promptZh: 這家公司因為侵犯版權被罰款。
referenceEn: The company was fined for copyright infringement.
The company had to pay a fine because of copyright infringement.
rubricZh: 要用 infringement 當名詞（例如 copyright infringement）
「被罰款」可寫，例如 was fined、had to pay a fine 等
時態合理即可（例如 was fined、has been fined）

items.promptZh: 老師冤枉了他，以為窗戶是他打破的。
referenceEn: The teacher unjustly blamed him for breaking the window.
The teacher blamed him unjustly for the broken window.
rubricZh: unjustly 表示「不公正地、冤枉地」，可放動詞前或後（例如 unjustly blamed、blamed him unjustly 等）
「以為窗戶是他打破的」可寫，例如 blamed him for breaking the window 等
